requirement: TOS shall expose a single `tos` CLI entry point.
TOS shall maintain canonical project state under `.tos/`.
TOS shall inspect repositories and operational sources before asking intake questions.
TOS shall classify facts using the controlled truth-status enumeration.
TOS shall detect conflicts, stale evidence, and material unknowns.
TOS shall select and validate modules from project facts.
TOS shall require disposition of every foundation contract.
TOS shall build a dependency-aware task graph and identify the next valid work.
TOS shall compile bounded work orders with permissions and stop conditions.
TOS shall enforce independent review and evidence verification.
TOS shall bind evidence to exact versions and evidence classes.
TOS shall require negative controls for material gates and checkers.
TOS shall control lifecycle promotions and explain denial.
TOS shall support rollback, recovery, incident, and restore verification.
TOS shall install, remove, validate, and upgrade modules safely.
TOS shall support provider adapters without provider coupling in the kernel.
TOS shall propagate approved lessons into versioned controls and downstream upgrades.
TOS itself shall use least privilege, auditability, secret isolation, and tamper-evident records.
